subject: English
question_text: Why do we pay tribute to the language martyrs?
guide_solution: We pay tribute to the language martyrs because they sacrificed their lives to establish Bangla as a stage language in undivided pakistan.

It was named after George Everest, an Englishman who first surveyed the Himalayas in 1941. Many expeditions had been led to conquer Mount Everest. Some of them were abandoned. Many climbers who took part in them lost their lives. Sir Edmund Hillary from New Zealand and his companion Tenzing Norkay from Nepal led an expedition in 1953. The expedition was set out on March 10. As the climbers were going up, they set up camps at different places. They left some of their men and supplies in those camps. The highest camp was set up at 27,000 feet. Only Hillary and Tenzing reached that height on March 25. But the top was still 2,000 feet away. They went up and up.
